verdict.rationale: Check's first-party docs describe webhooks that send HTTP updates on payroll, employee and bank-information changes. Deliveries carry a Check-Topic header identifying the event type, and configured webhooks and their delivery attempts are summarized in the Console's Developer tab. Missing for 10: documented registration/subscription mechanics (API endpoint or console steps to register a URL), payload signing/verification and retry behavior details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Use Check API's webhooks to automatically receive HTTP updates when a payroll state changes, an employee updates their information, bank information is changed
Once configured, your webhooks and their delivery attempts will be summarized in the Check Console under the ‘Developer’ tab.
Each webhook request has a `Check-Topic` header that represents which type of API event the webhook is associated with.
